title: extractBashTargets: blanket staging flags set broadWrite so the reservation guard sees them
action: In packages/bee/lib/guards.mjs extractBashTargets: (1) in the git add|mv|rm branch, when the verb is add, collect the segment tokens up to the next separator and set broadWrite=true when the segment has --all/--update or a short cluster containing A or u (reuse hasGitShortFlag); (2) add a git commit branch that sets broadWrite=true when the segment has --all or a short cluster containing a (git commit -a/-am); plain git commit / -m unaffected. Extend packages/bee/tests/test_guards.mjs extractBashTargets cases with positives (git add -A; git add --all; git add -u; git commit -a; git commit -am msg) and negatives (git commit -m msg; git add file.js keeps exact target with no broadWrite; git log --all untouched). Then run the regen chain in this order: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.
must_haves: git add -A / --all / -u / --update sets broadWrite=true (combined short clusters like -Av count, via hasGitShortFlag)
git commit -a / --all / -am sets broadWrite=true; plain git commit and git commit -m do NOT
explicit-path behavior unchanged: git add specific.js still yields exactly that target, no broadWrite
tests cover each positive flag form plus negatives
regen chain run inside the cell; release_manifest --check green
